caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, earthenware jar with a wide mouth and narrow base, positioned upright at the center of a light beige background. The jar is rendered in shades of brown and ochre, with areas of white highlighting possible worn or chipped surfaces. The surface of the jar features decorative patterns in darker brown lines, including what appears to be a stylized animal, likely a deer or similar creature with antlers, as well as botanical motifs with curving stems and leaf shapes. The details are fine and linear, with the animal depicted in a walking stance, and the botanical elements arranged above and below the creature. The background is plain and unadorned, drawing focus entirely to the jar and its decorations.
title: Pa. German Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
